notes.title: First Look: Inventory & Equip Prototype in Action
notes.content:
After months of development, we’re excited to share a raw, work-in-progress preview of Vandaan’s inventory and equip flow. In this short clip, you’ll see how items snap into place on your character and immediately impact gameplay. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44026639/26a06de1f3fd027c4cf728444ae42eb3bfe73386.gif


While the interface you see is far from final, it’s all about refining the feel and we want your input.


Your feedback counts!

 Which icons do you think are missing?
 How should we arrange the slots?
 What effects would you like to see when equipping items?

Join us on Discord to help shape the UI design, suggest icon styles, and fine-tune the overall experience. Your feedback will directly influence the game!
